newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar shoots higher on close.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar shoots higher on close.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled up 0.06 cent to 10.39 cents a lb in the benchmark March contract, on fund buying near the close, dealers said.
The back months ended 0.02 higher to 0.02 lower.
Early trade buying in the March/May and in the May/July spreads lifted March to its high of 10.42, but liquidation pressured the contract to a low of 10.32, dealers said.
Prices drifted slightly over unchanged throughout the session and then bounced near the highs at the end of the day.
The market set its ten-point trading range early and did not attempt to push key resistance at 10.50 cents in March. The contract remained well above support at 10.23 cents.
March closed 0.04 higher at 10.37, traded 10.42 to 10.32 cents. The back months settled 0.02 higher to 0.02 lower.
